children.value: > Fact From Story: When expenditures exceed revenues, the government incurs a deficit

> Fact From Story:  The P5.768-trillion budget, to be supported mainly by P3.5-trillion tax revenues (based on 2023 tax revenue projections), would mean a budget deficit of some P2.268 trillion, to be funded by additional borrowings.
> > Fact From Story: When expenditures exceed revenues, the government incurs a deficit | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: The P5.768-trillion budget will be supported mainly by P3.5-trillion tax revenues.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: If the amount of support is less than the amount of the budget, then expenditures exceed revenues.
> > Fact From Story: The DBM calls a budget balanced when revenues match expenditures or disbursements. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: When expenditures exceed revenues, the government incurs a deficit | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A deficit is an amount by which something is less than what is required. | Commonsense Knowledge
